component.name: Combolite Studio
component.summary: Multi-model database management studio for db-combolite

description.p: Combolite Studio is the desktop client for db-combolite, an ultra-fast zero-heap embeddable multi-model database engine supporting relational tables, document pools with BM25 full-text search, vector collections with k-NN graph search, cross-model graph links with cardinality enforcement, and high-throughput time series.

ul.li: Browse, filter, and edit relational tables inline with primary key tracking
Document pools with JSON editor, BM25 full-text search, and revision history
Vector collections with cosine, dot, and Euclidean similarity search and PCA projection
Interactive 2D and 3D force-directed link graph visualizer with heat-map path tracing
Time series streaming charts with range inspection and append operations
CMBQL console with syntax highlighting, live diagnostics, quick-fixes, and explain plans

description.p: Initial release with native db-combolite C99 engine integration, CMBQL query console, 2D/3D graph visualization, and multi-model store management.
